blocks.html: The Borrower is a Dutch telecommunications company providing mobile, fixed-line and broadband services to residential and business customers. It is the largest mobile provider in the country with ~40% market share of consumer SIMs, double the share of the #2 player and is the largest owner of 5G spectrum, with no further 5G spectrum auctions planned until 2030 and 6G not anticipated until early 2030’s. The company operates a number of brands, which covers the full customer spectrum from premium to budget. The company has a relatively asset-light model with the tower business spun-out prior to the Sponsor’s ownership and rents the fibre network from various infrastructure providers.

blocks.html: The Company is the #2 European provider of DTM software and services. DTM enables secure, efficient and legally binding workflows often replacing manual paper-based processes with electronic signatures, identity verifications, digital certificates, and comprehensive audit trails. The Company offers end-to-end DTM services that are considered “compliance-critical” by its customers across various segments and industry verticals. DTM services tend to be embedded within client workflows, which typically makes them difficult to replace.
